content:
**Built provenance at capture (#738): actor is the configured handle from git config brain.actor, refused when unset; actorKind measured from the agent-marker env; issue derived from the branch, never fabricated; W3 refuses a branch-shaped actor at the write gate**

**What**: Added brain/scripts/lib/git-config.mjs (one git config --get primitive) and brain/scripts/memory/lib/capture-provenance.mjs (resolveActor from brain.actor with HANDLE_RE shared from format.mjs, refused by name when unset, malformed or @legacy; resolveActorKind from the env list in brain.agentEnv, AI_AGENT by default, human otherwise; resolveIssue: --issue wins, else the type/issue-N-slug branch, never fabricated; composeSource naming the instruments with the citation grammar stripped so agent-controlled text can never forge an issue on re-import). plainfiles.save wires the three resolvers before buildRecord, PLAINFILES_ACTOR_KIND is retired, W3 in validateWritableRecord refuses a branch-shaped actor at the appendRecord chokepoint (write path only; the 183 historical branch actors still read), exportObservation keeps the @legacy fallback for the legacy door and soft-rejects a recovered branch actor, classifyActor is rehomed to format.mjs with audit.test.mjs byte-unmodified, #542's consistency test is rewritten to pin the new rule, and a guard proves brain's own capture path never emits @legacy. The doctrine edits are two brain-amendment/1 drafts for the maintainer's promote.

**Why**: epic #864 task 2.2; the audit baseline showed 0 of 2360 records with a real handle actor and 2177 @legacy; #542 had ruled the branch actor not a defect and the maintainer reversed that on 2026-09-10 choosing operator + brain.actor = @csrinaldi (an agent capture carries the operator's handle with actorKind agent). This record is the first real capture under the rule.

**Where**: brain/scripts/lib/git-config.mjs, brain/scripts/memory/lib/capture-provenance.mjs, lib/format.mjs, lib/audit.mjs, lib/engram-export.mjs, backends/plainfiles.mjs, brain/scripts/i18n/{en,es}.mjs; openspec/changes/issue-738-provenance-at-capture/** incl. brain-drafts/.

**Learned**: a fresh review found that instrument text composed into the Fuente slot could carry issue #N and be re-imported as a fabricated issue (the #461 class); fixed by stripping the grammar. The first memory:save on every clone is refused until git config brain.actor is set once; --global covers all clones. The tripwire test stays green without the doctrine text, so the PR is single-author; the promote is a separate sitting.
source: plainfiles save on gandalf-ROG-Zephyrus-G15-GA503QR-GA503QR; actor from git config brain.actor; actorKind agent from env AI_AGENT=claude-code_2-1-266_agent; issue 738 declared via --issue
